result_on_issue: Held that ordering the defendant out of a residence at gunpoint was an in-home seizure requiring probable cause and a warrant or exigency, none of which existed.
summary: Wrote the opinion holding that officers who ordered the defendant out of a residence at gunpoint seized him inside the home without probable cause, a warrant, or exigent circumstances; reversed and directed suppression of the in-field identification, his statements during the seizure, and items found on his person.
